answer: Stop sybils with an ember burn: an agent burns one ember fee to register. Its beacon is re-checked by verifiers; one beacon for two identities burns the fee and revokes both. It is sealed by an ivory device key; a duplicate key voids the entry. Forging 1,000 pays 1,000 fees, keys, and proofs at 14x honest cost each: each key fits one device and one beacon, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents pay once and keep full rights.
